newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian government to review industrial reform.
newsitem.headline: Russian government to review industrial reform.

text.p: The Russian government will hold a meeting on Thursday to discuss the reform of industrial enterprises, a government spokesman said on Tuesday.
Igor Shabdurasulov said Deputy Economy Minister Sergei Vasilyev would present a report on reforming enterprises.
He did not say whether the ongoing government reshuffle would be completed by the time of the meeting or not.

Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin said on Monday Russia's government reshuffle would be largely completed this week, adding he planned to present most of his remaining nominations to the president on Wednesday.
